title: Distribute SSH Known Hosts / Authorized Keys Across a Node List
description: Reads a list of hostnames from a file and, for each one, adds it to a known_hosts file and/or pushes a public key into its authorized_keys over SSH -- for getting passwordless SSH working across a fleet without pdsh/Ansible.

variables.name: HOSTS_FILE
variables.prompt: Path to a file with one hostname per line

variables.name: SSH_PUBLIC_KEY
variables.prompt: SSH public key to install on each host (leave empty to skip)

variables.name: SSH_USER
variables.prompt: Remote SSH user to connect as

toggles.name: UPDATE_KNOWN_HOSTS
toggles.prompt: Scan and add each host's key to known_hosts (ssh-keyscan)
